title: Stay in control of preparation and recovery
description: Read run coverage, make separate privacy choices and recover drafts within their limits.

scenes.title: Begin with an available manual run
scenes.instruction: Save or discard career edits. On Today, check Prepare a cloud run and Preparation provider. Select Prepare today’s applications when available.
scenes.caption: Availability is reported in your workspace. Private saving does not start a run.
scenes.narration: Save or discard pending career edits and check that you have a confirmed, shareable fact. On Today, inspect preparation availability. Source-based preparation uses no external AI. Select Prepare today’s applications when the service permits it. A full pilot, missing configuration or allowance stop can make runs unavailable.

fields.label: Availability
fields.value: Check the actual workspace. This tutorial reports no live service state.

demo.note: Available external models require separate consent for the selected route.

scenes.title: Read partial results as partial
scenes.instruction: Inspect every lane in Run history & source coverage. Address reported issues before Resume run. Use Cancel run for queued or running jobs and refresh to confirm.
scenes.caption: Closing the page does not cancel a cloud run. A source failure is not proof that no jobs exist.
scenes.narration: Read the status, count and message for every source lane. A partial run may have usable outputs and missing coverage. Address the reported issue before using Resume run if available. Use Cancel run for a queued or running job, then refresh to confirm. Closing the page does not cancel cloud processing.

fields.label: Fictional lane B
fields.value: Unavailable: no coverage should be inferred.

demo.note: No real run, search or model call takes place here.

scenes.title: Make separate connection choices
scenes.instruction: Use Optional recurring preparation or Optional Gmail access only when needed and available. Check saved next-run details and confirm any returned mailbox.
scenes.caption: Pause retains current work. Cancel schedule also stops its latest queued or running scheduled job. No automatic sending.
scenes.narration: Recurring preparation is optional and uses the rules method. Check the saved next run after enabling it. Pause stops future scheduling and retains current work. Cancel schedule also stops its latest queued or running scheduled job. A separate manual run has its own Cancel run. Gmail connection and run reading consent are separate choices. A Gmail draft is unsent and requires its own recipient confirmation.

fields.label: Optional recurring preparation
fields.value: Not enabled in this fictional demo.

fields.label: Optional Gmail access
fields.value: Not connected in this fictional demo.

demo.note: Google sign-in alone does not authorize inbox reading.

scenes.title: Choose refresh recovery deliberately
scenes.instruction: In the free check, open Draft recovery (optional) and check Keep my draft in this tab across refresh if needed. Otherwise route recovery stays in tab memory.
scenes.caption: Optional tab storage lasts 30 minutes after your last change. Restored approval is cleared.
scenes.narration: The free check can return from memory when you navigate away and come back in the same tab within thirty minutes. Refresh recovery needs the separate Keep my draft in this tab across refresh choice. It stores the CV and vacancy in that tab for thirty minutes after your last change. Read a restored draft and approve again.

fields.label: Keep my draft in this tab across refresh
fields.value: Choose only if you want temporary tab storage.

fields.label: Restored approval
fields.value: Cleared; review and approval are required again.

demo.note: Anyone using this browser tab may see a retained draft.

scenes.title: Know what can return
scenes.instruction: Return to Job Loop in the same tab within 30 minutes for unsaved draft memory. Refresh, closing the tab or changing accounts clears it. Saved account records are separate.
scenes.caption: Recovered claim and contact confirmations reset. A saved account record is not a temporary draft.
scenes.narration: Job Loop keeps unsaved career, claim and new-vacancy edits only in memory for up to thirty minutes across page navigation. Refresh, closing the tab or changing accounts clears them. Recovered claim and contact confirmations reset. Saved account records are separate, and cloud runs may still continue. Read recovery help before relying on temporary memory.

fields.label: Route recovery
fields.value: Same tab and account, up to 30 minutes.

fields.label: After recovery
fields.value: Read the source again; fact and contact confirmations reset.

demo.note: This tutorial records no CV text, account details or browser draft.
